seg.seg_note: First quarter after the Fortive spin (2-Jul-2016): four segments - Life Sciences, Diagnostics, Dental, Environmental & Applied Solutions (+ Other = unallocated corporate). Former Life Sciences & Diagnostics split into Life Sciences (incl. Release has no segment table; segment sales / OP / depreciation / amortization and growth from 10-Q Note 13 and MD&A (three-month); prior-year quarters recast. Segment identifiable assets 30-Sep-2016: LS 19,764.4, Diagnostics 9,928.2, Dental 5,924.6, EAS 4,171.7, Other 1,508.6.

ngaap.guidance: Q4-16: GAAP diluted EPS $0.85-$0.89; adjusted diluted EPS $1.01-$1.05 (amortization $141.2m pretax / $111.5m after-tax, $0.20; tax effect ($0.04)). FY2016: GAAP diluted EPS $2.86-$2.90; adjusted diluted EPS $3.57-$3.61 (amortization $567.8m pretax / $444.3m after-tax, $0.81; early extinguishment charge $0.26; gain on resolution of acquisition matters ($0.02); gain on investments ($0.32); tax effect ($0.16); Fortive separation tax costs $0.14). Pending Cepheid acquisition (~$4.0bn, $53/share, announced Sep-2016) expected to close by end-2016; excluded from guidance. No core growth guidance in release.
ngaap.notes: First quarter with Fortive as discontinued operation; adjusted EPS from continuing ops excludes amortization, early-extinguishment charge (make-whole premiums on ~$1.9bn notes redeemed Aug-2016), gain on resolution of acquisition-related matters, gains on investments, significant acquisition costs, aggregate tax effect and discrete tax items. Item amounts from release footnotes (rounded $m except amortization). Release has no free cash flow table (YTD operating cash flow $2.4bn, +29%).
